The Library has a rich variety of collections and areas: paper books, journals, e-books, ejournals, thesis reports, and CDs. The total holdings of the City University Library have reached 21,000+ printed books. The City University Library has become a member of UGC Digital Library (UDL). The City University e-library Contains 1,20,000 e-books, 30,950 e-journals via HINARI, AGORA, ARDI, OARE, GOALI, and 3,500 ebooks via UDL. The books are in different fields: English Language and Literature, Law, History and Culture, Social Science, Physics, Chemistry, Mechanical engineering, Textile Engineering, Civil engineering, Electrical and Electronics Engineering, Agricultural Science, Medical Science, Pharmacy, Mathematics, Business, Economics, Management, and Religion. It’s an open shelf Library. Online Catalog, and online circulation services are powered by KOHA.
